title.narrative: Hectarage of mangroves and/or seagrass not damaged

description.narrative: Hectarage of mangroves and/or seagrass not damaged

comment.narrative: Based on the community estimates at the start of the project at least 30 of the 6945 hectares of mangroves and seagrass are protected and do not have violations. The defined baseline by the community in 2020 was 2083 hectares.The initial data in the logframe and interim report showed the total hectarage to be managed which is 6945.The project sites has a total of 5100 hectares Dapa300 has Pilar 800 has San Benito1000 has and Del Carmen3000 has. In addition a total of 1845 hectares of seagrass meadow can be found in the project sites.

At the end of the project there will be no illegal activities in 6945 hectares including the 5100 has mangroves and 1845 has seagrass beds. Seagrass status are also expected to improve into fair condition or 25 to 50 cover.
Minimal disturbances 15 observed inside mangrove areas and seagrass beds
